C1252.title: Chinese Students Hit with $170M Bond in Target Gift Card Scam
C1252.summary: On June 7, 2023, two Chinese-born students, Cheng Li (25) and Jiaxin Jiang (24), were stopped for a traffic check in Alachua County, Florida, where police found 1,764 altered gift cards plus a thermal pad, barcode scanner, and laptop in the vehicle, valued at $158,600. Investigation showed the pair belonged to a scam ring targeting Target and other stores, stealing gift cards, re-encoding and repackaging them, then returning them to shelves so that funds flow to criminal accounts when consumers activate them.
